headline: Reliance Power announces 2027 demat window for physical shares
hook: Share conversion window opens for Reliance Power
summary: Reliance Power (RPOWER) has opened a dematerialisation window for holders of its physical share certificates, allowing conversion to electronic form until 2027. The move aims to streamline shareholding and improve liquidity. Existing physical shareholders must submit their certificates within the window to receive demat holdings. This affects current shareholders and may increase trading activity in the stock. Indian retail investors holding physical shares should consider converting to demat to trade more easily.
